overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted its monthly Fresh Fridays program featuring an interview with Shiloh Baptist Church's new senior pastor, Rev. Dr. Jerron S. Green, followed by a live jazz set by the Samuel Batista Quartet.

items.title: Opening and Welcome
items.summary: Terry Carter welcomed attendees and viewers, acknowledged community partners, and read his poem 'Home Spun.'

items.title: Conversation with Rev. Dr. Jerron S. Green
items.summary: Rev. Dr. Green discussed his background, his calling to lead West Medford's historic Shiloh Baptist Church, and his priorities for church and community life.

items.title: Community Announcements
items.summary: Carter announced upcoming center programming, memorial services for Joanne Tyler, a vendor market, and an in-person bank vote to award a community grant.

items.title: Musical Performance by the Samuel Batista Quartet
items.summary: The Samuel Batista Quartet performed a series of original jazz compositions and traditional arrangements inspired by family and Panamanian heritage.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: Carter thanked the performers and partners and delivered final reminders regarding upcoming winter events and donor support.
